=== [D1] Fix 2: "Convert to Effect.fnUntraced" ===

--- file:///.src/effectFnOpportunity_layerComments.ts ---
import { Context, Effect, Layer } from "effect"

class Store extends Context.Service<Store, {
  readonly size: number
  readonly get: (key: string) => Effect.Effect<string>
}>()("Store") {}

export const layer = Layer.effect(
  Store,
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const prefix = yield* Effect.succeed("k:")
    return {
      // how many entries the store holds
      size: 1_000,
      get: Effect.fnUntraced(function*(key: string) {
          // look the key up
          return prefix + key
        }),
    }
  }),
)

=== [D1] Fix 5: "Convert to Effect.fn(\"get\")" ===

--- file:///.src/effectFnOpportunity_layerComments.ts ---
import { Context, Effect, Layer } from "effect"

class Store extends Context.Service<Store, {
  readonly size: number
  readonly get: (key: string) => Effect.Effect<string>
}>()("Store") {}

export const layer = Layer.effect(
  Store,
  Effect.gen(function* () {
    const prefix = yield* Effect.succeed("k:")
    return {
      // how many entries the store holds
      size: 1_000,
      get: Effect.fn("get")(function*(key: string) {
          // look the key up
          return prefix + key
        }),
    }
  }),
)
